anomalies.description: IDA prints round power-of-two offsets as hex; the prescribed decimal-only regex reads `a1 + 0x4000` as 0. Extraction parses hex. Occurrences: arm0 0x2000(pos 1694), arm1 0x4000(pos 21), arm2 0x8000(pos 47), arm4 0x10000 (pos 99 and 106). All five land exactly on the a+16128*i line of their position, so these positions are PERFECT-LINEAR, not anomalies.

Per-arm multiset of (value - b_ref*i) is IDENTICAL across all 8 arms: the same linear cells appear in a different textual order in some arms (decompiler reordered commutative operands / fused a copy). No structural per-voice difference.
